entries.title: Genesis 33:1
segments: ¶And Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau came, and with him four hundred men. And he divided the children unto Leah, and unto Rachel, and unto the two handmaids.

entries.title: Genesis 33:2
segments: And he put the handmaids and their children foremost, and Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph hindermost.

entries.title: Genesis 33:3
segments: And he passed over before them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.

entries.title: Genesis 33:4
segments: And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him: and they wept.

entries.title: Genesis 33:5
segments: ¶And he lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, Who [are] those with thee? And he said, The children which God hath graciously given thy servant. {with...: Heb. to thee}

entries.title: Genesis 33:6
segments: Then the handmaidens came near, they and their children, and they bowed themselves.

entries.title: Genesis 33:7
segments: And Leah also with her children came near, and bowed themselves: and after came Joseph near and Rachel, and they bowed themselves.

entries.title: Genesis 33:8
segments: And he said, What [meanest] thou by all this drove which I met? And he said, [These are] to find grace in the sight of my lord. {What...: Heb. What is all this band to thee?}

words.text: , What [meanest] thou by all this drove
. {What...: Heb. What is all this band to thee?}

entries.title: Genesis 33:9
segments: And Esau said, I have enough, my brother; keep that thou hast unto thyself. {keep...: Heb. be that to thee that is thine}

words.text: ; keep that thou hast unto thyself. {keep...: Heb. be that to thee that is thine}

entries.title: Genesis 33:10
segments: And Jacob said, Nay, I pray thee, if now I have found grace in thy sight, then receive my present at my hand: for therefore I have seen thy face, as though I had seen the face of God, and thou wast pleased with me.

words.text: , Nay, I pray thee, if now I have found
, and thou wast pleased with me

entries.title: Genesis 33:11
segments: Take, I pray thee, my blessing that is brought to thee; because God hath dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough. And he urged him, and he took [it]. {enough: Heb. all things}

entries.title: Genesis 33:12
segments: And he said, Let us take our journey, and let us go, and I will go before thee.

entries.title: Genesis 33:13
segments: And he said unto him, My lord knoweth that the children [are] tender, and the flocks and herds with young [are] with me: and if men should overdrive them one day, all the flock will die.

words.text: [are] with me: and if men should overdrive

entries.title: Genesis 33:14
segments: Let my lord, I pray thee, pass over before his servant: and I will lead on softly, according as the cattle that goeth before me and the children be able to endure, until I come unto my lord unto Seir. {according...: Heb. according to the foot of the work, etc., and according to the foot of the children}

words.text: . {according...: Heb. according to the foot of the work, etc., and according to the foot of the children}

entries.title: Genesis 33:15
segments: And Esau said, Let me now leave with thee [some] of the folk that [are] with me. And he said, What needeth it? let me find grace in the sight of my lord. {leave: Heb. set, or, place} {What...: Heb. Wherefore is this?}

words.text: that [are] with me. And he said
. {leave: Heb. set, or, place} {What...: Heb. Wherefore is this?}

entries.title: Genesis 33:16
segments: ¶So Esau returned that day on his way unto Seir.

entries.title: Genesis 33:17
segments: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth, and built him an house, and made booths for his cattle: therefore the name of the place is called Succoth. {Succoth: that is, Booths}

entries.title: Genesis 33:18
segments: And Jacob came to Shalem, a city of Shechem, which [is] in the land of Canaan, when he came from Padanaram; and pitched his tent before the city. {Shechem: Gr. Sychem}

entries.title: Genesis 33:19
segments: And he bought a parcel of a field, where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem's father, for an hundred pieces of money. {Hamor: Gr. Emmor} {pieces...: or, lambs}

entries.title: Genesis 33:20
segments: And he erected there an altar, and called it Elelohe-Israel. {Elelohe-Israel: that is God the God of Israel}
